mapper.select: SELECT * FROM arte_ai_tool_approval WHERE request_id = #{requestId} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE arte_ai_tool_approval SET status = 'expired', decision_reason = 'approval expired', decided_at = #{now}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE status = 'pending' AND expires_at <= #{now}
UPDATE arte_ai_tool_approval SET task_id = #{taskId}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE request_id = #{requestId} AND status = 'pending' AND task_id IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM arte_ai_tool_approval WHERE create_by = #{ownerId} AND status = 'pending' AND expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT a.* FROM arte_ai_tool_approval a INNER JOIN arte_ai_tool_task t ON t.task_id = a.task_id WHERE a.status IN ('approved', 'rejected', 'expired') AND t.status = 'waiting_approval' ORDER BY a.update_time, a.id LIMIT #{limit}
